requirement: Tires shall remain on the rim when inflated to the maximum rated pressure and subjected to a 2-hour test at that pressure. The tire-rim assembly shall not separate under normal operating conditions.
requirement_summary: Tires must stay on rim at max rated pressure for 2 hours without separation

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain tire and rim components
Tire retention test report per §1512.10(a) showing no tire-rim separation at max rated pressure

remediation: Ensure tire-rim compatibility and conduct tire retention test per §1512.10(a) at maximum rated pressure.

requirement: Inflatable tires shall have a maximum pressure rating marked on the tire sidewall. The marking shall be in the format 'Max. Inflate to ___ PSI/kPa' or equivalent.
requirement_summary: Inflatable tires must have max pressure rating marked on sidewall

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain tire components with pressure rating specifications
Product photo showing tire sidewall pressure marking

remediation: Mark maximum inflation pressure on tire sidewall per §1512.10(b).

requirement: Wheels shall be securely attached to the bicycle frame or fork. Quick-release mechanisms, if used, shall have a positive locking action and shall be clearly marked to indicate the open and closed positions.
requirement_summary: Wheels must be securely attached; quick-release must have positive locking and open/closed markings

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain wheel and axle/quick-release components
Product photo showing quick-release mechanism with open/closed position markings

remediation: Ensure wheels are securely attached and quick-release mechanisms have positive locking with open/closed markings per §1512.11(a).

requirement: Front and rear wheel hubs shall be securely attached and shall not loosen under normal riding conditions. Hub axle nuts shall be properly tightened to the manufacturer's specified torque.
requirement_summary: Hub axles must be securely fastened and not loosen during normal use

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain hub components with axle specifications
Spec sheet documenting hub axle torque specifications

remediation: Ensure hub axles are properly tightened to manufacturer's specified torque per §1512.12.
